- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment > 0.10) — reduce forecast by 5–10% for 30-day horizon.
- Underestimate prices in bearish sentiment (negative sentiment < -0.40) — add 5–10% to forecast, especially if recent 18-day mean is rising.
- Overshoot after sharp price spikes — cap forecast at 10% below peak of recent 5-day range.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast is > 15% above 30-day moving average, adjust downward by 2–5% per day until convergence.
- Lagged sentiment effect: if sentiment turns negative within 3–5 days, reduce forecast by 3–7% per day for next 7 days.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts consistently overestimate early in bearish sentiment — apply 5–8% downward correction if sentiment < -0.30 for 3+ days.
